name: Image-Captain
description: Image captioning with custom Transformer decoder comparing ResNet-50 (CNN) vs ViT-B/16 encoders on MS COCO 2017. Achieves 1.07 CIDEr with ViT. Includes beam search, backbone fine-tuning, and a Gradio demo.

paragraphs: A deep learning image captioning system that generates natural language descriptions from images using a custom Transformer decoder, trained on the MS COCO 2017 dataset. The project explores and compares two visual encoder architectures — ResNet-50 (CNN) and ViT-B/16 (Vision Transformer) — to study how different image representations affect caption quality.
A core goal of this project was to experimentally compare how different visual backbones affect image captioning:
features: Encoder comparison study — trained and evaluated with both ResNet-50 (CNN) and ViT-B/16 to compare how convolutional vs. attention-based visual features impact captioning performance
Custom Transformer blocks — hand-built multi-head attention encoder and decoder layers (not nn.Transformer wrapper)
Beam search decoding with length normalization (greedy decoding also available)
Backbone fine-tuning with learning rate scheduling and warm-up frozen epochs
Standard NLP metrics evaluation via pycocoevalcap (BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, CIDEr, SPICE)
